title: E-Inventory
description: My high-performance inventory management system for Fabric.
body:
# 📦 **E-Inventory**

> ### **My high-performance inventory management system for Fabric.**

I created **E-Inventory** because I wanted a cleaner, faster way to handle item overflow without dealing with bulky menus or laggy sorting. It’s built to be lightweight, stylish, and perfect for anyone who hates inventory clutter.

This mod is especially great for people who love going on **adventures in Minecraft** but get **annoyed** when their inventory fills up with random blocks and items every few minutes. Instead of stopping your journey to clear out your bags, E-Inventory handles the mess for you.

---

### 🚀 **What I built it to do:**

* **Custom Dashboard**
    I designed a modern "tech-style" UI so you can manage your settings without ever leaving the game.
* **Restrict Pickup**
    This stops you from picking up junk in the first place if your inventory is already at the limit I set.
* **Auto-Throw System**
    Most mods fail on big servers like **Hypixel** because the server forces items into your inventory. I built Auto-Throw as a "fail-safe." If a server forces the pickup, E-Inventory detects the item instantly and ejects it back out. **Even if you aren't holding the item, it will throw it automatically without you ever needing to have it in your main hand.**
* **Silent Mode**
    I added a toggle to silence the constant "pop" sound of items being removed, making long sessions much quieter.
* **Theming**
    You can use the slider in the settings to change the UI glow to whatever color you want.

---

### 🛠 **Performance**

I coded this mod to be as small as possible (only **70KB**!) so it won't impact your FPS or TPS. By focusing on clean Java logic and no heavy textures, I kept the footprint as small as possible.

---

### 📖 **Getting Started**

* **Default Key:** Press **'R'** to open the dashboard.
* **Settings:** Use the sub-panel to toggle automation features like **Silent Trash** and **Auto-Throw**.

---
